_comment: Template. Copy to <name>.json and edit. This file is never loaded as a site. name/wp_base/chat_id are required; everything else falls back to the defaults in shared/config.py. BulkFollows service ids are per site so a channel with different geo targeting can use a different service. emoji_pool is opt-in by design: the full catalogue in orders.py includes shit/clown/throw up, which must never land on a client's news post by accident.
